title: Agentic engineering and vibe coding
summary: Four builders showed what they made with AI agents this month: a self-custody simulator, mempool visualizers that rain lightning tips, a Bitcoin open-source issue finder and a voice-driven orchestrator for coding agents.
share_text: Agentic engineering + vibe coding for Bitcoin: a self-custody simulator, mempool games, an issue finder and an agent orchestrator. Notes + every tool from the @CodeOrangeDevs workshop
tldr: You don't need to code to build: describe what you want, speak instead of typing, and let the agent do the work.
Andy's self-custody simulator lets newcomers practise a hardware wallet, a seed backup and a recovery before using real bitcoin.
A one-shot HTML page plus the mempool.space API became a set of live transaction visualizers with lightning tips that rain on every viewer's screen.
The next step is orchestration: one agent you talk to that hands work to builder and reviewer agents in Claude, Codex and Hermes.
